name: How much does exterior house painting cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does exterior house painting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of exterior house painting varies significantly based on several factors, including the size and style of your home, the condition of the existing surfaces, and the type of paint chosen. Prep work, such as power washing, scraping, and minor repairs, also impacts the final price. For homes in Huntington Beach, Irvine, or Orange, we offer free, detailed estimates after an on-site evaluation to provide an accurate quote tailored to your specific project needs. This ensures transparency and helps you understand the full scope of the investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior painting costs vary by house size, condition, paint type, and necessary prep work. We offer free, detailed estimates after an on-site evaluation.
